captureMethod.focus: Pointer click into the rendered paragraph, then Chrome keyboard Meta+A.
captureMethod.sourceSelection: Selection.toString() is recorded as a separate diagnostic value.
captureMethod.clipboard: Chrome keyboard Meta+C is sent without a copy handler; navigator.clipboard.read() captures the real clipboard formats.

normalization.textPlain: Exact text/plain string returned by Chrome Clipboard API; no trimming, Unicode normalization, newline conversion, or reconstruction.
normalization.textHtml: Only availability, SHA-256, and UTF-8 byte count are stored; the clipboard HTML blob is not copied into the fixture.
normalization.mathmlBranch: Recursive tag/attribute/text tree of the KaTeX MathML semantic branch, including its TeX annotation.
normalization.htmlVisualBranch: Recursive tag/class/innerText tree of KaTeX’s visual HTML branch; it is distinct from the MathML semantic branch.
